BrochureContent.Content:
Lynam Auctioneers are delighted to present this substantial four-bedroom family home, superbly positioned on a generous corner site within the highly sought-after Nutgrove Park, Clonskeagh. Offering exceptional space both inside and out, this property presents a rare opportunity for discerning purchasers to create a truly outstanding family home in one of South Dublin's most desirable residential locations.

While the property requires complete refurbishment and modernisation, it boasts vast living and sleeping accommodation, providing an excellent foundation for a comprehensive renovation. The generous corner site offers exciting scope to extend and reconfigure the existing layout, subject to the necessary planning permission, while still retaining a large private garden. Off-street parking further enhances the appeal of this exceptional home. 

The location is second to none. Quietly nestled within the mature surroundings of Nutgrove Park, the property enjoys a peaceful setting while remaining within easy reach of Milltown, Bird Avenue, Donnybrook and Ranelagh. The Milltown LUAS stop is just a short walk away, providing excellent connectivity to Dublin City Centre and beyond.

The area is renowned for its outstanding educational facilities, with Alexandra College, Sandford National School, Sandford Park School, Muckross Park College and Gonzaga College all within walking distance. University College Dublin (UCD) is just a few minutes’ walk away, while Trinity College Dublin is also easily accessible.


An excellent selection of recreational and sporting amenities are close by, including Milltown Golf Club, David Lloyd Riverview, Brookfield Tennis Club and Dartry Health Club, while the nearby Dodder Linear Park provides a beautiful setting for walking, running and cycling.

Properties of this calibre, offering such generous proportions, a superb corner site and outstanding potential in an established and prestigious location, rarely come to the market. This is an exceptional opportunity for buyers seeking to create their forever home in the heart of Clonskeagh.

Substantial four-bedroom family home
Generous corner site with excellent potential

Potential to extend, subject to planning permission
